company.shortDescription: Parallels is an application for Mac that allows users to run Windows, Linux, operating systems, and applications
company.description: Parallels develops cross-platform virtualization and automation solutions which allow users to access applications, files, and computers in one place on any device or operating system. They offer businesses and individuals solutions built for Mac, Windows, iOS, AndroidTM, and the cloud.
